candidates.title: UP bizman death case: Nagpur court grants UP cops transit remand for Shraddha Dubey
candidates.excerpt: Nagpur court has provided transit remand to Uttar Pradesh Police for the three accused in a murder case. Shraddha Dubey and her accomplices were arrested following intensive police operations and public tips. The accused had been evading arrest, prompting an increase in the reward for information leading to them. Shiva Sharma's mother expressed gratitude towards the police for their efforts in achieving these arrests.

candidates.title: After HM visit CBI team begins investigations into killing of anti-drug activist, CBI registers FIR
candidates.excerpt: A team from the Central Bureau of Investigations arrived in Mansa to investigate the murder of Parwinder Singh Jhota. The investigation was prompted by demands from Jhota's father and a local action committee for justice. Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited the bereaved family and assured them of justice before the CBI's arrival. The CBI is expected to collect evidence pertinent to the case and conduct a thorough investigation.

candidates.title: What's Chennai's plan to lower flood risk?
candidates.excerpt: Chennai's flood risk is increasing due to rapid urban expansion and declining vegetation and water bodies. Recent studies identified particularly vulnerable areas, confirming gaps in drainage coverage and infrastructure. The Greater Chennai Corporation has implemented measures to enhance stormwater drainage networks and prepare for flooding. Initiatives include creating shelters and mobilizing resources to manage water levels during monsoons.
